dr25_koi.csv.query: select kepid,kepoi_name,kepler_name,koi_disposition,koi_pdisposition,koi_score,koi_fpflag_nt,koi_fpflag_ss,koi_fpflag_co,koi_fpflag_ec,koi_comment,koi_period,koi_period_err1,koi_time0bk,koi_time0bk_err1,koi_duration,koi_depth,koi_tce_plnt_num,koi_tce_delivname from q1_q17_dr25_koi where kepid in (2445134,4678875,5785279,6611330,7898352,8231830,8822421,9047416,10352333,10470206,10587105,11342416,11442793) order by kepid,kepoi_name

keplernames.csv.query: select kepid,koi_name,kepler_name,pl_name from keplernames where kepid in (2445134,4678875,5785279,6611330,7898352,8231830,8822421,9047416,10352333,10470206,10587105,11342416,11442793) order by kepid,pl_name
